messages:
alex: Quick note — I'm doing a focused refresh of the Quickstart 'hello world' onboarding to use Auth v2 + the new SDK init pattern. PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427. Need a docs + SDK snippet sanity check before merge. cc @maria @jordyn

maria: Thanks! I'll take a pass on the auth flow and wording this afternoon. Do we still show the local proxy approach?

alex: Keeping the local proxy as an optional section, but default examples should be direct SDK auth (API key + project). Proposed Python snippet at top of PR:```bash
# install
pip install redwood
``````python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY", project="hello-world")
resp = client.chat.create(system="You are helpful.", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}])
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

sam: Nice. Can you add the env var example for mac/linux and a quick note on secrets manager for dedicated/private? Small copy tweak: "project" -> "workspace" in JS snippet we use elsewhere.

alex: Good catch — will align naming. Also updated the Node snippet to match our SDK v0.9 surface; included redirect-uri example for web quickstart.

jordyn: Quick UX ask — can we surface a one-line migration callout at the top: "If you used the old quickstart, update your init as shown"? Makes it easier for returning devs.

alex: Done in the PR — added a yellow callout block and a short checklist of breaking changes (auth header name, client init param rename, streaming flag).

maria: I ran the examples locally, one thing: the Python snippet returns an object shape change (choices -> outputs). Need to mention both shapes until next SDK release. I left an inline comment on the PR.

alex: Thanks — I'll add a compatibility note and a tiny helper snippet to map old -> new response.

deploy-bot: docsite build queued for branch quickstart/auth-v2-refresh (job #8843) :gear:

docs-bot: lint check failed on code-block formatting in docs/quickstart/hello-world.md line 74 — missing language tag on fenced block.

alex: On it, fixing the fenced blocks and a stray raw URL that broke link parsing. Will push in ~10m.

sam: Also saw a broken internal link to /sdk/node/auth in the troubleshooting section. I can patch after you push if you want.

alex: Please do if I don't get to it in time. Also planning to add a short migration guide file (docs/migrations/auth-v2.md) with CLI commands and a list of config keys to rename.

jordyn: Timeline? We want this live before the onboarding demo on Wed.

alex: Aiming to merge today EOD. If we hit blockers, can we feature-flag the new snippets behind an experimental toggle so platform demos can opt-in?

maria: Fine by me. If merge slips, I'll keep slide deck pointing to the branch URL.

alex: pushed fixes — CI re-run requested: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/97223345

deploy-bot: docsite build started (job #8845) :rocket:

docs-bot: build succeeded. Preview link: https://deploy-preview-1427--docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-world

sam: Preview looks good. I left two tiny wording nits in the quickstart steps (step 3 and the env var example).

alex: addressed both nits and added the migration guide stub. One open TODO: add an example showing how to rotate API keys for Dedicated customers. @jordyn can you drop a short blurb?

jordyn: Will add a 3-line section by EOD.

maria: approving the PR once rotation blurb is in. Great work on tightening the flow, Alex. :tada:

alex: thanks all — merging after rotation blurb. If anyone wants the branch earlier for demos, ping me and I'll enable the preview link permanently.

sam: LGTM after blurb.

alex: merged and backfilled migration guide. Leaving this thread open for any fallout.

docs-bot: PR #1427 merged into main by alex — docs site redeployed (job #8845) :white_check_mark:
